أنهرس (form VII)
# أَنْهَرِسُ (ʔanharisu) /ʔan.ha.ri.su/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْهَرَسَ (inharasa)
# أَنْهَرِسَ (ʔanharisa) /ʔan.ha.ri.sa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْهَرَسَ (inharasa)
# أَنْهَرِسْ (ʔanharis) /ʔan.ha.ris/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْهَرَسَ (inharasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
